pr_title: [ML] add new trained_models/{model_id}/_infer endpoint for all supervised models and deprecate deployment infer api
pr_body:
This commit adds a new `_ml/trained_models/{model_id}/_infer` API. This api works for both native NLP models and supervised models trained via Data Frame analytics. 

The format of the API is the same as the old `_ml/trained_models/{model_id}/deployment/_infer`. Taking a `docs` and an `inference_config` parameter.

This PR also deprecates the old experimental `_ml/trained_models/{model_id}/deployment/_infer` API.

The biggest difference is that the response now nests all results under an "inference_results" object.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/86032

issue_context.title: [ML] Extend the _infer endpoint to support all model types
issue_context.body:
### Description

NLP models have a very useful [_infer](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/infer-trained-model-deployment.html) API for quickly evaluation. However, Boosted tree models created by Data Frame Analytics jobs and the build in `lang_ident` model cannot be evaluated in the `_infer` endpoint as it only applies to NLP models which are deployed. This is evident in the full URL which contains the `deployment` keyword

`_ml/trained_models/<model_id>/deployment/_infer`

For models that do not need to have deployments the `_infer` URL should be:

`_ml/trained_models/<model_id>/_infer`

It is less confusing to have a single `_infer` endpoint, the second form should be preferred over the first and the first deprecated. 

For models that need to be deployed before they can be evaluated the current sensible error messages should be retained.

review_comments:
We needed an external name for interaction at the REST layer and since inference needs to work during rolling upgrade, we cannot get rid of the old action name.

So, both point to effectively the same transport class.
